title: Nurses and clinical officers process from Uhuru Park to Afya House over PPE and insurance
location: Uhuru Park to Ministry of Health/Afya House, Nairobi
scope: one Nairobi public procession; no national aggregation
organizer: Kenya Union of Clinical Officers and Kenya National Union of Nurses members
threshold_50_evidence: Article confirms procession and demonstration but no number or clearly supported >=50 estimate; pending threshold.

start_date.summary: Text and image captions identify Monday 14 Dec 2020.

location.summary: Gathered at Uhuru Park and proceeded to Ministry of Health headquarters/Afya House, Nairobi.

occurrence.summary: The Star reports a peaceful protest/procession.

demands.summary: Demanded PPE and comprehensive medical insurance; article also mentions risk allowances.

notes: Do not count entire strike workforce as rally attendance; one physical Nairobi group only.
open_questions: Attendance, end date, independent corroboration and exact episode relation to other December healthcare actions.

title: Uasin Gishu medics barricade county headquarters in Eldoret
scope: local gathering; event date inferred as Wed 16 Dec from story published Thu 17 Dec; reviewer confirmation needed
organizer: Striking county health workers; union representatives identified
participants_original: Article calls it a crowd of nurses/clinicians; no number.
threshold_50_evidence: “Crowd” without quantitative or clear qualitative scale is insufficient to establish 50; pending threshold.

start_date.summary: Story published 17 Dec and says Wednesday evening; inferred 16 Dec, not explicit calendar date.

location.summary: Governor’s office/Uasin Gishu county offices, Eldoret.

occurrence.summary: Health workers barricaded entrance for many hours with twigs/placards.

demands.summary: Address grievances to resume work: insurance, promotions, Health Services Commission, PPE and allowances.

state_response.summary: No county official addressed them; Governor absent; no other response detailed.

notes: This is a physical county-office gathering, not the strike alone; keep separate from Dec14 Nairobi procession.
open_questions: Exact date, attendance, end and relation to separately reported Makueni demonstration.
